nodes.label: PluginSettings + DEFAULT_SETTINGS + PROTECTED_EXCLUDES
nodes.rationale: PROTECTED_EXCLUDES (.git/**, plugin logs) are backfilled onto saved excludePatterns on every load because saved arrays fully replace defaults - prevents the plugin's own writes from self-triggering sync on installs with old persisted settings. setupInProgress/setupStartedAt coordinate concurrent plugin instances during repository setup.
